title: Graph Edge
description: Shared interchange format for graph edges. Used by EntityGraph output and Nexus graph. Consumers: nexus, shift, entity-graph.

source.description: Source entity ID. Must match a node id in the same graph.

target.description: Target entity ID. Must match a node id in the same graph.

weight.description: Edge weight — number of drawers in which source and target co-occur.

edge_type.description: Semantic edge type. co-occurrence: entities appear in the same drawer. dependency: one entity depends on the other (from framework.yaml). provenance: one entity is the origin decision for another. temporal: entities are connected by time sequence.
